writing_turn.answer:
[writing-specialist]

# Growing Together: Community Tomato-Planting Workshop This Saturday

Fresh tomatoes, backyard pride, and new neighbors: this Saturday, the community garden hosts our tomato-planting workshop. Whether you are a seasoned grower or planting your first seedling, you will leave with a free starter plant, heirloom seeds, and the know-how to grow a strong summer crop.

Our master gardeners cover choosing a variety for your sun, hardening off seedlings, spacing, feeding, and the simple staking tricks that keep plants upright through August wind. Everything is hands-on, so bring gloves and expect to get your hands in the dirt.

Saturday, 9:00 a.m. to noon, at the community garden on Maple Street. Tools and soil provided. Free for neighbors, and kids of every age are welcome. Rain or shine, we plant anyway.

By Wren Editor (writer-76b5104d)
